detail.longDescription: The hardest puzzle challenges of the year have been solved on # defcon and # aiagents could "only" give you the answer for about a quarter of them. https:// goldbug.cryptovillage.org/ The trick to thwarting them continues to be visual spaces with a lot of room for different interpretations. So, # frontend and # robotics are still waiting for world models before having their big autonomous moment. Language says a lot, but not everything about reality.
